subject: chimpanzee
title: Wild Chimps Eat About Two Drinks' Worth of Alcohol Every Day

scenes.text: Wild chimpanzees take in about two drinks' worth of alcohol a day. They never touch a bottle.
Ripe fruit ferments a little on the tree, as yeast turns sugar into alcohol.
Scientists tested twenty-one fruits that chimps eat in Uganda and Ivory Coast. On average, about a quarter of a percent alcohol.
But a chimp eats around ten pounds of fruit a day.
That adds up to about fourteen grams of pure alcohol, roughly two drinks for a chimp's body size.
They don't seem to get drunk. They've just been doing it for millions of years.

description:
A 2025 study in Science Advances (UC Berkeley) measured ethanol in 21 fruit species eaten by wild chimpanzees at Ngogo, Uganda and Taï, Ivory Coast, averaging around 0.26 to 0.3%.
With about 4.5 kg of fruit a day, chimps ingest an estimated 14 g of ethanol daily, roughly two standard drinks adjusted for body weight. The intake is estimated, and they are not thought to get drunk.
What other animal do you think eats fermented food?
first_comment: Some scientists think our taste for alcohol started with fruit like this. Which animal would you expect to get tipsy first?
